edits.old: The five criteria in section 7 (AC2, AC4, AC8, AC10 and AC11) are the ones this story owns.
edits.new: The criteria in section 7 (AC2, AC4, AC8, AC10, AC11, AC12, AC14 and AC15) are the ones this story owns.

edits.old: Then the read is never served unscoped
edits.new:
Then the read is never served unscoped

  Scenario: AC12 Stale source product (exception X7)
    Given a source product of the measure set is stale on 2026-12-15
    When the dashboard shows the measures for 2026-12-15
    Then the previous day 2026-12-14 is shown with its date
    Then MSG-P1-001 is shown

  Scenario: AC14 Error answers of the provided operations (401, 403, 404)
    Given a caller of GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases
    When the caller sends the request without a valid credential
    Then the response is 401
    Given a role without Case record R
    When it calls GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases?cutOffDate=2026-12-15
    Then the response is 403 as in AC10
    Given the caller requests a resource that does not exist
    Then the response is 404

  Scenario: AC15 Consumed call fails or does not answer (exception X6)
    Given a consumed call fails or does not answer
    When it calls GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases?cutOffDate=2026-12-15
    Then the read is refused
    Then the read is never served unscoped
